in_sanskrit.name: Bijon
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of seeds
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bijon एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bijon is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bija', which means seed. This name is a tribute to the divine creator Lord Brahma, who is believed to have created the universe from a seed. The name Bijon is thus a symbol of creation, potential, and growth.
